critical_issues.msg: VALID_STATUSES has 7 values but CustomerStatus enum only has 4 (LEAD, OPPORTUNITY, CUSTOMER, INACTIVE); storing status 'prospect', 'partner', 'active', or 'blocked' via update_customer/change_status succeeds, but count_by_status raises KeyError when those DB values are used as keys in {CustomerStatus(row[0]): ...}.
critical_issues.suggestion: Align VALID_STATUSES with CustomerStatus members, or broaden the enum to include all valid statuses. Add a defensive lookup: try CustomerStatus(row[0]) except ValueError: skip or log.

suggestions.msg: Parameter 'tags: str | None' is accepted but never used in the method body — dead parameter with no effect on the query.
suggestions.suggestion: Either implement the tag filter (e.g., conditions.append(CustomerModel.tags.contains(tags))) or remove the parameter.

suggestions.msg: Keyword is wrapped in '%' for LIKE matching but '_' and '%' within the keyword itself act as wildcards (e.g., search 'test_1' matches 'testX1').
suggestions.suggestion: Escape special LIKE characters before wrapping: import re; kw = re.sub(r'([%_\\])', r'\\\1', keyword); kw = f'%{kw}%'

suggestions.msg: NotFoundException message uses Chinese characters '客户' (customer) — inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses English.
suggestions.suggestion: Use 'Customer' (matching the pattern of other NotFoundException usages).

suggestions.msg: NotFoundException message uses Chinese characters '客户' (customer) — inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses English.
test_list_customers asserts 'len(items) >= 3' — this only creates 3 customers in this test, so the '>=' allows unrelated tenant data from other tests to silently make the assertion pass.
suggestions.suggestion: Use '== 3' and rely on db_schema (TRUNCATE CASCADE) to ensure isolation, or assert with a known minimum that is strictly from this test.

suggestions.msg: test_list_customers_pagination asserts 'total1 >= 5' and 'total1 >= 5' — only 5 customers are created in this test, so '>=' makes the assertion pass if any other tests left data in the shared tenant.
suggestions.suggestion: Use '== 5' to ensure the test is truly isolated and deterministic.

suggestions.msg: test_list_pipelines asserts 'len(items) >= 2' — only 2 pipelines are created in this test, so '>=' allows pre-existing tenant data to silently satisfy the assertion.

test_count_by_status_returns_correct_counts uses 'tenant_id_web' fixture while test_count_by_status_empty (line 427) uses plain 'tenant_id' — mixing tenant fixtures within the same test class makes it harder to reason about isolation boundaries.
suggestions.suggestion: Standardize on one tenant fixture (e.g., tenant_id) or clearly document why the REST-based tests require tenant_id_web.

suggestions.msg: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])) hardcodes the repo root and duplicates PYTHONPATH setup already handled by the integration conftest and documented in CLAUDE.md — fragile when run from different working directories.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the sys.path manipulation and rely on PYTHONPATH=src (exported in .env or the shell environment) as the single source of truth.

suggestions.msg: mock_db_session fixture sets session.refresh = AsyncMock(), then individual tests reassign it to a plain function (e.g., fake_refresh); this overwrites the fixture-level mock unnecessarily.
suggestions.suggestion: Define fake_refresh within each test that needs it and pass it to the service constructor directly, or make the fixture accept a configurable refresh callable — avoid mutating the shared fixture object.
